items.title: Every nonempty locally closed subset of the space of a stack meets the set of points of finite type
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.work: Stacks Project — Morphisms of Algebraic Stacks
items.source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file stacks-morphisms.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: The counted statement shows that every nonempty locally closed subset of the space of an algebraic stack meets the set of points of finite type, and that for a closed subset that intersection is dense (author lemma at source lines 3766-3777, label lemma-enough-finite-type-points). The proof (source lines 3779-3795) realises the subset as the space of its reduced induced substack, compares points of finite type along the immersion, and produces one from a closed point of an affine presentation (proof lines 3779-3794). The reduction to the substack and the comparison of finite type points are the content. H2.
